entity.name: RelyMD

We are fostering healthier communities and workplaces through real-time access to community-based providers, nationwide.

Founded by a group of innovative emergency medicine physicians and healthcare entrepreneurs, we’re on a mission to simplify people’s lives by delivering reliable, trusted medical care anytime and anywhere, to ultimately foster healthier communities and workplaces.

Our journey began when co-founder and chief medical officer, Dr. Bobby Park, received a call about a cut that his niece had sustained. It was after hours for the pediatrician and urgent care center, and his sister didn’t know if it required emergency care. Dr. Park was able to examine the wound via video on his smartphone, determine it wasn’t serious, and provide care instructions. No emergency visit was necessary, saving his sister lots of time and money. And, voila! The idea for RelyMD was born.

We are proud to help lead the national movement to break down barriers to high-quality, reliable care and participate in the march towards value-based care, right here from our home in Atlanta. To us, it’s only natural that you should be able to see a doctor using the same digital tools you use to plan a trip, book a hotel, or call a ride. High-quality Medical care can be convenient, effective, and on-demand.

My Virtual Physician provides the entire range of consults from simple acute visits to complex visits. My Virtual Physician offers patients in the virtual space the full range of services they would get in a comprehensive multi-specialty clinic in the brick and mortar world. 

If a patient needs a referral we will do all the paperwork. If a patient needs a medical exemption letter for work we will write it. If a patient needs a specialized imaging study, we will coordinate it. If a patient has social needs we will connect them to a community health worker.

My Virtual Physician is blazing a trail in the telehealth world in the US.

Our mission is simple: to help patients stay healthy and present for the moments that matter most — anniversaries, graduations, family milestones, and everyday life. Because every extra year of health is a gift.

CareClix enables remote consultations in a seamless and secure environment between patients and physicians and allows for the sharing and collaboration of clinical data between all parties involved. This revolutionary technology enables doctors to see patients in their clinical settings virtually as well as at home via a variety of remote health monitoring devices. CareClix is transforming healthcare and has become one of the most powerful online tools allowing for medical collaboration worldwide.
